name: apple-messages
description: Read, search, and send iMessage, SMS, and RCS conversations on macOS — messages, chats, attachments, and contact-resolved names.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Apple Messages on your Mac.

**Features:**
- Search your whole history by text, sender, chat, and date range
- Read conversations with paging back through history
- iMessage, SMS, and RCS, including group chats
- Contact names resolved from your Contacts cards
- Attachments listed and retrievable
- Tapbacks, edited messages, and threaded replies surfaced
- Compose a message with the text prefilled, and press send yourself

**Requirements:**
- macOS 13 Ventura or later (RCS requires macOS 26 or later)
- **Full Disk Access** for the Claude app — System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Full Disk Access. Quit and reopen Claude afterwards.
- Automation permission for Messages — needed to resolve contact names and to send. macOS prompts automatically.

**Why Full Disk Access is required:** unlike the Apple Mail extension, Messages cannot be read through scripting. Its AppleScript dictionary exposes chats and participants but no message class, so message bodies are only available from the Messages database.

**Sending:** `compose_message` opens Messages with your text prefilled and stops, so you press send. `send_message` delivers immediately and is deliberately harder to trigger.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Overview of the Messages database: totals, unread count, per-service breakdown (iMessage/SMS/RCS), and date range

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List conversations, most recently active first, with participants and a preview of the latest message

tools.name: get_chat_messages
tools.description: Read messages from one conversation, oldest-first, with paging back through history

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search message bodies across all conversations, filtered by chat, sender, and date range

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one message in full, including attachments and delivery timestamps

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Retrieve an attachment's bytes as base64

tools.name: refresh_search_index
tools.description: Warm or rebuild the local index that makes full-history search possible

tools.name: compose_message
tools.description: Open Messages with a recipient and text prefilled, without sending — you press send

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to an existing conversation. Delivers immediately and cannot be unsent
